extraction_text: No limitation shall be placed on the amount of work which an employee shall perform during the work day, nor shall there be any restrictions against the use of machinery or labor-saving devices.

attributes.context: The preceding text identifies the equipment as Hydraulic Seeder, Stump Remover, Hydraulic motorized pin puller, and Bo Mag walk-behind type roller on asphalt, and states that their operation may raise jurisdictional questions among local unions.
